subject: Two quick questions about priority & blockers for a Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@rocketline.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Two quick questions about priority & blockers for a Redwood pilot

Hi Samir — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and two very short questions so we can prioritize next steps: 

Recap (2 min):
- We walked through a 20-min demo of Redwood inference runtime and how it would integrate with Rocketline's search pipeline.
- Your main goals: improve latency for reranking, reduce per-request cost, and give the ML team predictable rollout paths for model updates.
- You called out security/audit requirements and data residency as deal-breakers if not addressed.

Two quick questions (yes/no is fine):
1) Is moving a pilot into Q4 a priority for Rocketline now, or is this likely pushed into next quarter?
2) Any regulatory/blocker on the procurement side we should know about (e.g., vendor security questionnaire, PO timing, or legal review windows)?

Next practical steps I propose: I can share a brief mutual-action-plan (attached) that maps stakeholders and a 6-week pilot path + three dates to choose from for a technical kickoff. If Q4 isn't a fit, we're happy to sketch a light proof-of-concept timeline for later.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — appreciate any quick direction.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Samir — just circling back on the note below. Wanted to keep this as short as possible: 

- Quick ask 1: Could you flag whether the pilot is a Q4 priority for your org?
- Quick ask 2: If there is a procurement lead or a standard security questionnaire, could you share the contact or the doc? We can pre-fill answers so the legal/procurement review is faster.

If helpful, Alex (cc'd) can run a short 15-min technical skimming session with your infra/ML lead to scope the minimal integration work for a pilot — no commitment required.

If now's not the right time, a one-line reply like "later" or "low priority" is totally fine and we'll pause outreach. If still interested, I can send three kickoff windows for you to pick from.

Thanks again — trying to keep things efficient.
